name: Differentiable Sphere Tracing
definition: A differentiable rendering method using Signed Distance Functions (SDFs) and Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) to render scenes via ray marching, supporting gradient computation with respect to scene parameters.
summary: Differentiable Sphere Tracing is a GPU-optimized rendering algorithm for neural Signed Distance Functions that enables efficient inverse graphics optimization by providing differentiable forward and backward passes.
